Edit only the supplied isolated layer of the approved snowy railway-station game background. The art director says the overall battlefield is too visually cluttered: DELETE competing environmental objects and simplify large shapes. Do not beautify by adding details. Retain the approved restrained cool blue-gray dusk palette and hand-inked painterly 2D drawing. Quiet broad painted planes, few deliberate edges. Keep exact wide 1659x948 canvas registration (aspect 7:4), camera and station floor at y=68%, so the same foreground, characters and ground positions still align. Absolutely no characters, UI, text, contact sheet or new scene objects. Output exactly ONE full-canvas layer, never a recomposed full scene.
FAR BACKDROP only, fully opaque. Remove all small sharp cloud patches and warm sunset flecks. Reduce the entire sky to a few very broad soft slate-blue cloud washes and a simple cool luminous mist band across y=48..65%. Push the bridge much further into the fog: retain only an extremely faint, low-contrast long horizontal bridge silhouette at the same y=47..60%, eliminate ALL crisscross truss marks, repeated triangles, bolts and fine structure; at most three ghostlike support masses. Remove most city towers; only one or two broad almost-imperceptible haze silhouettes near lower horizon. Snowfield is calm large pale blue-gray planes, no little snow ridges. The entire central x=25..90%,y=28..68% should have quiet low-contrast empty atmosphere for battle figures and labels. No train, station shelter, signal posts, foreground beams, lantern, floor or rails.
